profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Ellington
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software development professional experienced in the financial institutions sector as well as other areas.  

Areas of expertise: technology leadership, software engineering best practices, end-to-end enterprise systems, in-depth Excel VSTO development.

Technical strengths:  FinCAD, Python (Flask, Restplus, SQLAlchemy, Pandas), Typescript, Node.js, Angular 6, ngrx/store, Electron, Docker, Material Design, Bootstrap, Sass, CSS, all things C#, WPF, SQL Server, VSTO, Active Directory Federation Services, Sharepoint SDK.

I've written the following software:
- Pricing curve tools and visualization for financial services sector
- Various real-time analytics systems for financial sector
- Rules-driven internet security layer for health insurance provider
- Remediation system for a pension fund
- BASEL-compliant corporate loans system for financial sector
- Web Travel Insurance system
- PBX Routing/Case Logging system for health insurance sector
- Real-time scheduling system for spa/hospitality industry
- Personnel safety monitoring system for private security sector
